banner.reopenHint: You can reopen it any time from your profile menu.
banner.intro: We verify your identity to prevent fake profiles and bots. When you meet all requirements you'll receive your unique ID and your verification badge will activate.

requiredInfo.intro: All fields are required. You can hide them from the public in settings — the administrator will see them for verification.

photos.intro: Upload 5 photos. The first will be your profile photo; the second, your cover.

terms.body: By requesting verification, you accept that (1) the information provided is real and verifiable, (2) your identity document will be reviewed by administrators for verification purposes only, (3) the platform may revoke your verification if false data is detected. Read the full terms at /terms and the data policy at /privacy.
terms.acceptLabel: I have read and accept the additional terms for verification.

document.pendingTitle: Your request has already been submitted and is under review.
document.pendingBody: Administrators will review your identity document. You'll receive a notification when it's approved or rejected.
document.openFullSize: Tap the image to view it full size.
document.rejectedHint: Fix what was flagged and submit again. Your photos and information remain saved.
document.intro: Upload your ID or identity document. Only the administrator will see it. We accept images (JPG/PNG/HEIC) up to 10 MB.
document.fileTypes: JPG, PNG or HEIC · Max. 10 MB
document.stepsHint: Complete steps 1, 2 and 3 before submitting your request.
